lines: I don't want to think about it much.
Surely, you think of the day before life's end.
Ah, someday on the final day, your absence.
You know, how do you tell that the sky is blue?
I guess you just have to convey it.
How do you describe the night clouds being high?
They'd call me someone who doesn't understand.
Write it down so I don't forget.
Let's meet at the platform at ten tomorrow.
Even when the peony falls, it's still a flower.
Even after summer leaves, longing remains sharp.
And if on the final day you can be seen.
Surely, even on the last day, you'd sing love.
Because you say everything wasn't in vain.
Ah, someday on the final day.
I still can't believe you're gone.
